import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import os from 'node:os';
import {createServer} from 'file:///C:/Users/arstot/Documents/Codex/2026-09-20/抽卡人生/cardgrid/node_modules/vite/dist/node/index.js';
const {chromium}=await import('file:///C:/Users/arstot/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs');
const root='C:/Users/arstot/Documents/Codex/2026-09-20/抽卡人生/cardgrid';const out=path.join(os.tmpdir(),'cardgrid-g2-readonly-annotation-'+Date.now());await fs.mkdir(out,{recursive:true});
const server=await createServer({root,configFile:path.join(root,'vite.config.ts'),logLevel:'error',server:{host:'127.0.0.1',port:0}});await server.listen();const url='http://127.0.0.1:'+server.httpServer.address().port+'/';
const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true,executablePath:'C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe'});const results=[];
async function setup(p){await p.goto(url);await p.waitForLoadState('networkidle');await p.evaluate(async()=>{const fx=await import('/tests/fixtures/action/independent.ts');const {createWorkspaceStore}=await import('/src/store.ts');const {createWorkspaceClient}=await import('/src/workspace-client.ts');const s=createWorkspaceStore();const d=fx.confirmed();const second={...d.planner.instances[0],id:'i2',creationSnapshot:{...fx.content(),title:'第二事实'},currentContent:{...fx.content(),title:'第二事实'}};d.planner.instances.push(second);d.planner.handOrder.push('i2');await s.atomic(()=>({write:fx.envelope(d),result:null}));const c=createWorkspaceClient({store:s,now:()=>fx.AT});try{const load=await c.load();const r=await c.previewActual({token:load.value.token,draft:{instanceId:'i2',instanceVersion:7,mode:'unplanned',start:{date:'2026-09-28',time:'11:00',zone:'Asia/Shanghai'},end:{date:'2026-09-28',time:'11:17',zone:'Asia/Shanghai'}}});if(!r.ok)throw Error(JSON.stringify(r));const submit=await c.submit({commandId:'second-confirmed-fact',expected:r.value.token,type:'ConfirmActual',payload:{previewId:r.value.previewId,acknowledgedOverlap:null}});if(!submit.ok)throw Error(JSON.stringify(submit));}finally{c.close();}});await p.reload({waitUntil:'networkidle'});await p.locator('nav').getByText('抽卡手牌').click();await p.getByRole('tab',{name:'当日',exact:true}).click();await p.getByLabel('日期',{exact:true}).fill('2026-09-28');await p.getByLabel('为 第二事实 添加批注').waitFor();}
async function hold(p,count){await p.evaluate(count=>{window.__heldAnnotationCompletes=[];const orig=IDBDatabase.prototype.transaction;let remaining=count;IDBDatabase.prototype.transaction=function(names,mode,...rest){const tx=orig.call(this,names,mode,...rest);if(mode==='readwrite'&&remaining>0){remaining--;let complete;Object.defineProperty(tx,'oncomplete',{get(){return complete;},set(fn){complete=fn;tx.addEventListener('complete',event=>window.__heldAnnotationCompletes.push(()=>fn.call(tx,event)),{once:true});}});if(!remaining)IDBDatabase.prototype.transaction=orig;}return tx;};},count);}
async function release(p,index){await p.evaluate(index=>window.__heldAnnotationCompletes[index](),index);}
async function state(p){return p.evaluate(async()=>{const {createWorkspaceStore}=await import('/src/store.ts');const s=createWorkspaceStore();try{return await s.read();}finally{s.close();}});}
async function check(name,fn){const context=await browser.newContext({timezoneId:'Asia/Shanghai',serviceWorkers:'block'});const p=await context.newPage();p.setDefaultTimeout(5000);try{await setup(p);const detail=await fn(p);results.push({name,status:'pass',detail});console.log('PASS',name);}catch(e){const result={name,status:'fail',error:e.stack,state:await state(p),ui:await p.locator('body').innerText()};results.push(result);await p.screenshot({path:path.join(out,name+'.png'),fullPage:true});console.log('FAIL',name,e.message);}finally{await context.close();}}
try{
 await check('independent-annotation-pending-disables-own-input-preserves-other-draft',async p=>{const a=p.getByLabel('为 独立合成行动 添加批注'),b=p.getByLabel('为 第二事实 添加批注');await a.fill('第一事实提交');await b.fill('第二事实旧草稿');await hold(p,1);await a.locator('..').getByRole('button',{name:'添加批注',exact:true}).click();await p.waitForFunction(()=>window.__heldAnnotationCompletes.length===1);assert.equal(await a.isDisabled(),true);assert.equal(await b.isEnabled(),true);await b.fill('第二事实保存期间的新草稿');await release(p,0);await p.getByText('第一事实提交',{exact:true}).waitFor();assert.equal(await a.inputValue(),'');assert.equal(await b.inputValue(),'第二事实保存期间的新草稿');return{ownInputDisabled:true,otherDraftPreserved:true};});
 await check('independent-two-annotation-requests-keep-separate-busy-and-drafts',async p=>{const a=p.getByLabel('为 独立合成行动 添加批注'),b=p.getByLabel('为 第二事实 添加批注');await a.fill('并发甲');await b.fill('并发乙');await hold(p,2);await a.locator('..').getByRole('button',{name:'添加批注',exact:true}).click();await p.waitForFunction(()=>window.__heldAnnotationCompletes.length===1);await b.locator('..').getByRole('button',{name:'添加批注',exact:true}).click();await p.waitForFunction(()=>window.__heldAnnotationCompletes.length===2);assert.equal(await a.isDisabled(),true);assert.equal(await b.isDisabled(),true);await release(p,0);await p.waitForFunction(()=>!document.querySelector('input[aria-label="为 独立合成行动 添加批注"]').disabled);assert.equal(await b.isDisabled(),true);await a.fill('甲保存后新草稿');await release(p,1);await p.waitForFunction(()=>!document.querySelector('input[aria-label="为 第二事实 添加批注"]').disabled);assert.equal(await a.inputValue(),'甲保存后新草稿');assert.equal(await b.inputValue(),'');const d=(await state(p)).data;assert.equal(d.planner.annotations.filter(x=>x.text==='并发甲').length,1);assert.equal(d.planner.annotations.filter(x=>x.text==='并发乙').length,1);return{separatePendingState:true,firstNewDraftRetained:true,eachSavedOnce:true};});
}finally{await browser.close();await server.close();await fs.writeFile(path.join(out,'results.json'),JSON.stringify({at:new Date().toISOString(),results},null,2));console.log('Evidence:',out);}
if(results.some(x=>x.status==='fail'))process.exitCode=1;
